Name: Monster Hunter Wall Art

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds 20 unique monster icons. All are accessible through the catalog.[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Features wall art for: Rathalos, Zinogre, Nargacuga, Gore Magala, Lagiacrus, Nergigante, Rathiam, Deviljho, Mizutsune, Paolumu, Odogaron, And more! [/color]
[/size]
All art is available through Robin's Furniture Catalog.
